The Indiana Secretary of State 2026 Candidate Guide states: 'Indiana has no elections to city offices (Mayor, Common Council, and Judge of the City Court) in 2026. These offices were elected at the municipal election in 2023.' Only cities with a population under 3,500 that opted in may elect some officials in 2026; Fort Wayne is far above that size. The guide names 2027 and 2031 as the municipal election years. The Indiana Election Division historical results list Fort Wayne mayoral contests in 2011, 2015, 2019 and 2023. The official 2026 election calendar (November 2025 to November 2027) was also opened. No mayoral round was held in 2026.
